## WorkOS change

Reason: Replace with why this change exists
Scope: Replace with the bounded change and what stays out
Owner GO: Replace with the exact Owner authorization for this action
Tests: Replace with the checks that ran and their result
Risks: Replace with the remaining risk or known limit
Evidence: Replace with proof and known limitations

An existing Notion record may be cited with `Notion Record ID` and `Notion Record URL`. Both lines are optional. Leave them out when there is no record.

## Checklist

- [ ] Owner GO covers this exact scope.
- [ ] Reason, scope, tests, risks and evidence are specific to this pull request.
- [ ] No real Cloud/DB write, deploy, migration or merge is implied by this pull request.

Governance: [GITHUB_PRIMARY_TRACEABILITY_V1](https://github.com/office952/workos-po/blob/main/docs/governance/GITHUB_PRIMARY_TRACEABILITY_V1.md)
